answer: The zephyr report shows the merge explicitly at each opal. Each collapsed cluster gets one delta weight, one vote, and one jury seat regardless of how many keys it holds. Because of that, a hostile operator who spins up 248 aliases from one source ends up with the same influence as one agent, paying 131 times the capital for one share. A farm of 3238 identities would post 2378 proofs and burn roughly 7 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
